claims.claim_text: The indexed Victor Cordovi has a confirmed Army-record identity and is the Victor A Cordovi whom an industry memorial and NARA finding aid explicitly connect to OSS.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact private identifier selects a 1942 Army row with a 1911 birth-year value; HerbalGram names Victor A Cordovi, born in Sofia in 1911, as an OSS volunteer, and NARA lists a 1944 OSS cable under his rare name.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Exact private identifier and exact name confirm the Army identity; the rare name, matching 1911 birth-year evidence and two explicit OSS sources bridge the memorial.
claims.temporal_assessment: HerbalGram places arrival in January 1941 and OSS volunteering after a short time; the Army record is dated October 1942. A company history instead says arrival in 1943, so no exact pre-OSS interval is asserted.
claims.match_notes: The 1941/1943 arrival-date disagreement remains visible. No postwar spice employer or Army occupation code is presented as a pre-OSS employer.
